I am an old woman of 78 years and I have never been to school. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer, new seeds, or sprays from the shop. My children and grandchildren will help me hoe this small plot, plant the seeds we kept from last harvest, and pull the weeds by hand when the rains come. We have no pump or pipe for water, so we depend only on the rain God sends us.
